request.style: English, upbeat acoustic pop, bright male vocal, acoustic guitar strums, piano, glockenspiel, claps, bass, drums, encouraging, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The master went away on a journey
He gave his servants what he had
Five to one and two to another
One to the last, and he wasn't glad

[Verse]
The first one traded and he doubled it
The second one did the same
But the third one dug a hole in the ground
And hid it away in shame

[Chorus]
Well done, good and faithful servant
You have been faithful with a little
I will put you in charge of much
Come and share your master's joy

[Verse]
Whatever you have, a song or a story
A pair of hands, a listening ear
Don't bury it under your fear and worry
Take it out and use it here

[Chorus]
Well done, good and faithful servant
You have been faithful with a little
I will put you in charge of much
Come and share your master's joy

[Bridge]
Don't hide it, don't bury it
Bring it to the light
Don't hide it, don't bury it
Let it shine bright

[Outro]
Come and share your master's joy
